title: Sesame Herb Hummus with Crudites
steps: Blend the drained chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, and olive oil until smooth, loosening with cold water.
Pulse the parsley through at the end, so the dip stays flecked rather than green.
Cut the carrots, cucumber, and bell pepper into sticks and serve alongside.
goldenRuleCallouts: Sesame paste gives this its body, so it needs no tree-nut cream of any kind.
Raw vegetables carry the dip, which keeps a processed cracker out of the snack rotation.
